title: WEHI-SODA-Hub/sp_segment pipeline - params.aviti_input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.aviti_input. This is a fully separate samplesheet/schema from the COMET/MIBI params.input schema: an AVITI row represents one run directory, not one pre-segmented TIFF, and its downstream routing (well/tile discovery, dual Cellpose segmentation, per-well stitching) shares no code path with the existing Mesmer/SOPA-Cellpose/CellSAM subworkflows.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

run_dir.errorMessage: run_dir must be an existing directory containing RunParameters.json and a Projection/ subdirectory

wells.errorMessage: wells must be a colon-separated list of WellLocation values (e.g. 'A1:A2'), or left empty to process every well in the run
